title: Spicy Algerian-Style Lentil Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious gluten-free dish made with lentils and aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: pilaf oil
ingredients.notes: such as olive or avocado oil

instructions: Heat the pilaf oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cumin and cayenne pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and water (or broth) to the saucepan.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the lentils are tender, about 20-25 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and season with salt to taste.
If desired, top with crunchy chopped almonds.
